out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Inspect Premises
violations.observation: The premises is not being routinely inspected for the presence of insects, rodents and pests. Observed several fruit flies in the food prep area of the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Insects, rodents and pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Routinely inspect the premises to control the presence of insects, rodents and pests on the premises. Contact your pest control company and have them treat the establishment for fruit/drain flies. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Ice As Coolant Not Used as Food
violations.observation: Ice used as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food is also for beverage ice or used as food. A bottle of wine and three water bottles were stored in the ice in the ice bin.
violations.corrective_action: After use as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food, packaged foods, beverages, or cooling coils/tubes, the ice may not be used as food. Discontinue storing containers of foods in the ice bin. The PIC moved the bottles to a refrigerator during the inspection to correct. CDI.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed bowls, colanders, and other food equipment stored on the floor under the 3-vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Discontinue storing equipment and utensils on the floor. All equipment and utensils must be stored at least 6 inches off the floor, on approved shelving whether clean or not. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Materials Smooth, Durable, Cleanable
violations.observation: The ceiling tiles located in the kitchen are the incorrect type; they absorbent and not easily cleaned.
violations.corrective_action: Wall, floor, and ceiling surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, warewashing areas, and toilet rooms. Replace the ceiling panels in the kitchen with restaurant grade type that are smooth and easily cleanable ones. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed several holes in walls behind equipment in the kitchen..
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Move equipment from the wall and repair the holes to eliminate pest harborage areas within the establishment.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED ICE SCOOP BEING STORED ON TOP OF ICE IN ICE MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: ICE SCOOP REMOVED AND WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens, Prohibited Storage Areas
violations.observation: OBSERVED CLEAN POTS AND PANS BEING STORED UNDER THE THREE-VAT SINK ON UNCLEAN SURFACES.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned and sanitized equipment, utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items may not be stored in: 1) locker rooms, 2) toilet rooms, 3) garbage rooms, 4) mechanical rooms, 5) under sewer lines that are not shielded to intercept potential drips, 6) under leaking water lines including leaking automatic fire sprinkler heads or under lines on which water has condensed, 7) under open stairwells, or 8) under other sources of contamination. PLEASE INSTALL SHELVING TO STORE THESE ITEMS AS INDICATED ABOVE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Cutting Board, When to Resurface or Discard
violations.observation: The cutting board along the ONE-DOOR PREP-TOP IS heavily scratched and scored. The food contact surface is no longer easily cleaned and sanitized due to condition.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces such as cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED GAPS IN CEILING AROUND PLUMBING FIXTURES AND A LARGE HOLE IN A CEILING TILE.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection. UPON ARRIVAL THERE WAS NO CFM PRESENT.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CDI: CFM CAME BEFORE END OF INSPECTION. ENSURE A CFM IS ALWAYS ON SITE.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' PIC/CFM UNABLE TO PROVIDE EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. CDI: EHS PROVIDED CFM WITH EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICIES TO FILL OUT AND KEEP ONSITE.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. PIC/CFM UNABLE TO PROVIDE CLEAN UP PROCEDURE FOR VOMITING AND DIARRHEA.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CDI: EHS PROVIDED CFM WITH CLEANUP PROCEDURES. ENSURE THESE ARE ALWAYS KEPT ON SITE. CAFE LE MIRAGE (Inspection Date: 06/10/2025) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at THE handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. NO HANDWASHING SOAP ON SITE. SOAP FOR HANDWASHING MUST BE PROVIDED AT ALL TIMES. BUY SOAP AND ALWAYS KEEP AT THE HANDWASHING SINK TO BE USED FOR PROPER HANDWASHING.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW QUAIL, RAW BEEF, AND RAW SHRIMP ON THE SAME SHELF AS RTE FOODS SUCH AS GINGER AND HERBS IN THE 1DOOR PREP-TOP COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: RTE AND RAW FOOD PRODUCTS SEPARATED WITHIN COOLER.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED NO DATE MARKING OF ANY PREPARED FOOD IN FACILITY INCLUDING COOKED FISH.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. DATEMARK FOODS WITH DATE OF PREPARATION AND DATE OF USE. EX. IF THE COOKED FISH WAS PREPARED ON 6/1/2025 IT MUST BE USED OR DISPOSED OF BY 6/7/2025.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: UPON ASKING CFM IF ANY FOOD IS SERVED RAW OR UNDERCOOKED, THE FOLLOWING DISHES ARE SERVED RAW OR UNDERCOOKED AND NO CONSUMER ADVISORY IS ON THE MENU: -Bo tai chanh -Bo luc lac -Bo xao sate -Bo gia Nai Lang Van -Bo xao can chua -Duoi Bo sate -Be thui
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. THE ABOVE ITEMS AND ALL OTHER ITEMS SERVED RAW OR UNDERCOOKED MUST HAVE A CONSUMER ADVISORY AND AN ASTERISK MARKING THE DISH AS PARTIALLY RAW OR ENTIRELY RAW.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED SPICES AND FOODS WITHOUT LABELS ON THEIR WORKING CONTAINER.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. ALL FOODS IN WORKING CONTAINERS MUST BE LABELED WITH COMMON NAME OF FOOD.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED BEER OUTSIDE THE KITCHEN AND WATER BOTTLES IN THE KITCHEN STACKED ON THE FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ALL BEVERAGES AND FOOD MUST BE RAISED 6 INCHES ABOVE THE FLOOR. UTILIZE DUNNAGE RACKS OR OTHERWISE CLEANABLE RACK.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. OBSERVED THREE WET WIPING CLOTHS ON COUNTER NOT HELD IN SANITIZER SOLUTION.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CDI: WET WIPING CLOTHS MOVED TO CHLORINE SANITIZER SOLUTION DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Cutting Board, When to Resurface or Discard
violations.observation: The cutting board(s) along the 1DOOR PREPTOP IS heavily scratched and scored. The food contact surface is no longer easily cleaned and sanitized due to condition.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces such as cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. CAFE LE MIRAGE (Inspection Date: 06/10/2025) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not resistant to corrosion: OBSERVED FROZEN RAW MEAT IN FREEZER STORED DIRECTLY IN PLASTIC GROCERY BAGS
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. FOODS MUST BE STORED IN AN NSF APPROVED BAG. UTILIZE FREEZER BAGS MADE FOR FOOD STORAGE.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the HOT WATER HEATER piping are leaking. OBSERVED LEAKING INTO A BUCKET NEAR HANDWASHING SINK AND SPLASHING INTO HANDWASHING SINK FROM THE HOT WATER HEATER MOUNTED IN THE CEILING.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. HOT WATER HEATER MUST BE REPAIRED SO THAT IT IS NOT LEAKING.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. OBSERVED THE INTERIOR OF THE ICE MACHINE IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Employees' medicines are not properly located to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE MEDICATION STORED OVER FOOD PREP SURFACE
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. PIC MOVED MEDICATION TO AN AREA AWAY FROM FOOD PREP SURFACES.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor around equipment in the kitchen is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
